gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3505 names 'dextrins and other modified starches'; the goods are chemically modified starches with minor additives that do not change their character
GRI 1: heading 3809 applies only to products 'not elsewhere specified or included', so it yields to the specific heading 3505

classification.rationale: Cato Size 52A and Cato 15A are chemically modified starches used as paper sizing agents. Heading 3505 specifically provides for modified starches, while heading 3809 covers paper finishing preparations only when not elsewhere specified or included, so 3505.10.00 applies under GRI 1. NY G81194 classified these exact products in 3809.92.50, but its status is revoked, which is consistent with the move to 3505. The statistical suffix assumes corn-derived starch.
